latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* [Backport 2.34] fix(api): do not block the operator-configured executor URL as an SSRF target (#3856) (#3860) by @alfespa17 in https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/pull/3872
* [Backport 2.34] fix(executor): leave -backend-config arguments out of init when the HTTP backend is on (#3857) (#3858) by @alfespa17 in https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/pull/3873
* [Backport 2.34] fix(api): link policy notifications to the UI (#3863) by @alfespa17 in https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/pull/3874
* [Backport 2.34] fix(ui): don't warn about missing output for steps that were not executed (#3823) by @alfespa17 in https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/pull/3875
* [Backport 2.34] fix: Update terraform-spring-boot-starter version to 1.9.0 to allow destroy with opentofu (#3878) by @alfespa17 in https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/pull/3880
* [Backport 2.34] fix(api,ui): filter pull request webhooks by target branch (#3847) by @alfespa17 in https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/pull/3881


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube/compare/2.34.0...2.34.1
